headlineOfDay: Iran and the US trade strikes around Bahrain, Kuwait and Hormuz as Trump, Xi and Putin prepare a first three-way summit in China.

markets.summary: Wall Street fell sharply, with the S&P 500 down 1.0% and the Dow down 1.6%, as the VIX rose for a fourth day and software stocks sold off. The FTSE 100 lost 1.8% and the Euro Stoxx 50 2.2%, with miners weak as metals fell. Brent slipped to about $92 and gold, silver and copper all dropped.
